Look directly at the awareness that knows this present moment: the knowing itself has no gender, no nationality, no age, and no suffering. It is like pulling the plug on a cinema projector: the dramatic movie of thoughts instantly collapses into the blank, peaceful white screen. Anchor your understanding in direct seeing rather than speculative theory.
